title: Camera special moments — round-resolve zoom-in + spawn flicker-in (closing visual-style.md §7.4)
intent: Two small camera polish moments from `docs/game-design/visual-style.md §7.4` that have never shipped. (1) ROUND-RESOLVE ZOOM-IN: when a round resolves (phase flips to won/lost/draw), the camera slowly zooms in on the winning bomber (or arena centre on draw) over 1.0s, from the start of round-end up to the banner display. Sells the moment without becoming cinematic. (2) SPAWN FLICKER-IN: when a bomber spawns (round-start in solo, drop-in in multiplayer), the camera does a 0.3s 'flicker-in' from above — fast vertical drop-in into framing. Reuses the existing spawn-flash VFX. Both moments small, both anchored to gameplay events. No cinematic cutscenes; players never lose control. Builds on S163 camera-follow.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/visual-style.md §7.4` — Special camera moments section. Both moments named with concrete timings but never filed as stories. Pairs with S163 camera-follow (provides the camera-position machinery + damping). Small in scope: each moment is ~40 LOC + a tween over the camera Y position. Together they add ~80 LOC. Marked `could` because the camera already feels good post-S163 — these are flourish moments, not core fixes.
acceptanceHints: DEPENDS ON: S163 camera follow (shipped). Optional: GDP-2026-05-28-001 lighting (no hard dep — both work pre-shadow).
PART 1 — ROUND-RESOLVE ZOOM-IN (camera-special-moment-system extension):
Trigger: RoundState.phase flips from 'playing' → 'won' / 'lost' / 'draw' (existing detection in RoundResolveSystem).
Behaviour over 1.0s (between phase-flip and banner display):
Identify camera target: winning bomber's position OR arena centre on 'draw'.
Lerp the camera-follow target Y (existing camera state from S163) DOWNWARD by 1.5 cells over 1.0s — gives the zoom-in feel without changing field-of-view.
OR: change view size (if orthographic) from ~11 tiles to ~7 tiles over 1.0s — actual zoom.
Recommended: option A (Y-down) — simpler, no view-size flicker.
After 1.0s zoom + 3.0s banner display, when auto-restart fires (existing): smoothly lerp camera Y BACK to default in 0.4s before scene reload, so next round opens at normal framing.
TOTAL added camera animation: 1.0s zoom-in + 3.0s held + 0.4s zoom-out + scene reload = ~4.4s. Matches the existing auto-restart 3-second window plus a small buffer.
PART 2 — SPAWN FLICKER-IN (camera-special-moment-system extension):
Trigger: a bomber entity newly spawns (PlayerControlled + first spawn, OR after round-restart + GridPosition newly set, OR after multiplayer drop-in spawn).
Behaviour over 0.3s:
Camera Y starts at +1.5 cells above default follow Y.
Lerps DOWN to default follow Y over 0.3s with ease-out.
Spawn-flash VFX (existing — visual-style.md §6.2 'Spawn flash' planned VFX, may already be shipped) fires simultaneously at the bomber's cell.
Only fires for the LOCAL player's bomber spawn — not for remote bombers (would be a flicker-per-bomber-spawn in busy multiplayer, distracting).
In solo + multi-bot mode: triggers on round start.
In connected multiplayer: triggers on joinWorld OR after spectate-until-next-round transition (per GDP-027-012).
INTERACTION WITH EXISTING CAMERA-FOLLOW (S163):
Both moments WRITE the camera's target position; the existing damping system handles the lerp. No new tween primitive needed.
Round-resolve zoom-in WINS over camera-follow during the moment (the camera locks on the winning bomber instead of the dead local-player or the spectator centre).
Spawn flicker-in WINS over camera-follow at the spawn moment (camera dips in from above before transitioning to normal follow).
After each special moment ends, camera-follow takes over with its normal logic.
IMPLEMENTATION SHAPE (examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/camera-special-moments-system.ts):
Singleton system tracking 'in special moment' state with timestamp.
Per fixedUpdate (or renderUpdate): if in zoom-in or flicker-in state, override the camera's target position written by camera-follow-system from S163. Otherwise, no-op.
RoundResolveSystem fires a 'special-moment-start' event when phase flips. Spawn integration: on bomber spawn (PlayerControlled component newly written), fire 'spawn-flicker-in' event.
MULTIPLAYER (server-authoritative gameplay from S125):
Server's RoundState phase flip already in snapshot. Each client sees the round-resolve event + runs zoom-in independently. No protocol changes.
Spawn flicker-in fires when local client's Presence entity is first decorated (S109 remote-bomber-decorator-system).
URL CONFIG:
`?specialCamera=off` disables both moments — useful for screenshot tests + replay.
`?zoomInDurationS=N` overrides 1.0s zoom-in.
`?flickerInDurationS=N` overrides 0.3s flicker-in.
PERFORMANCE: negligible. Camera state already animated per frame by S163 system; this adds 1 extra dt-lerp during the moments.
DETERMINISM: pure presentation. Bot-vs-bot regression unaffected.
UNIT TESTS:
Round-resolve phase flip → camera Y lerps down by 1.5 cells over 1.0s.
Round-resolve on draw → camera centres on arena (no winner).
Spawn → camera Y starts at +1.5 above default, lerps down to default over 0.3s.
Remote bomber spawns → no flicker-in for local camera (only local-player spawn triggers).
`?specialCamera=off` → both moments disabled, camera-follow-system always wins.
Auto-restart after zoom-in → camera Y resets to default within 0.4s before scene reload.
VISUAL QA:
Round resolves, player wins → camera zooms in on player bomber, banner shows on top, 3s pass, auto-restart fires + camera resets smoothly.
Round resolves, draw → camera zooms to arena centre.
Local player spawns at round start → camera does a brief flicker-in from above. Feels like 'arrival'.
Solo + multi-bot mode (no spawn animation for bots): only local-player gets flicker-in.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Cinematic cutscenes — visual-style.md §7.4 explicit ban: 'No cinematic cutscenes ever.'
Player-disable zoom-in / flicker-in via in-game toggle. URL flag only.
Different zoom-in for different outcomes (e.g. epic zoom for streak win). Single style.
Audio sting tied to zoom-in. Existing round-resolve audio + win/lose banner audio sufficient.
Spawn moment for accessories detach (GDP-027-012) — separate VFX.
Replay / spectator camera animations beyond this. Out — replay-camera is a separate system not yet filed.
